name: Set.powersetCard.sumEquiv_symm_val
statement:
theorem sumEquiv_symm_val (n : ℕ) (k : Fin (n + 1))
    (s : powersetCard I k) (t : powersetCard J (n - k)) :
    ((sumEquiv n).symm ⟨k, s, t⟩).val = s.val.disjSum t.val

name: T3.ExteriorTensor.blockTensorEquiv_apply_coe
statement:
theorem blockTensorEquiv_apply_coe (n : ℕ) (k : Fin (n + 1)) (z : TensorBlock R V W n k) :

name: T3.ExteriorTensor.exteriorBasis_disjSum_coe
statement:
theorem exteriorBasis_disjSum_coe {p q n : ℕ} (h : p + q = n)
    (s : Set.powersetCard I p) (t : Set.powersetCard J q) :
    ((b.prod c).exteriorPower n
      ⟨s.val.disjSum t.val, by rw [Set.powersetCard.mem_iff, Finset.card_disjSum,
        s.property, t.property, h]⟩ : ExteriorAlgebra R (V × W)) =
      (exteriorPower.map p (LinearMap.inl R V W) (b.exteriorPower p s) :
        ExteriorAlgebra R (V × W)) *
      (exteriorPower.map q (LinearMap.inr R V W) (c.exteriorPower q t) :
        ExteriorAlgebra R (V × W))

name: T3.ExteriorTensor.range_wedgeMap
statement:
theorem range_wedgeMap (n : ℕ) (k : Fin (n + 1)) :

name: T3.ExteriorTensor.tensorBasis_apply
statement:
theorem tensorBasis_apply (n : ℕ) (k : Fin (n + 1))
    (s : Set.powersetCard I k) (t : Set.powersetCard J (n - k)) :
    tensorBasis b c n ⟨k, s, t⟩ =
      DirectSum.lof R _ (TensorBlock R V W n) k
        (b.exteriorPower k s ⊗ₜ[R] c.exteriorPower (n - k) t)

name: T3.ExteriorTensor.tensorEquiv_basis
statement:
theorem tensorEquiv_basis (n : ℕ) (k : Fin (n + 1))
    (s : Set.powersetCard I k) (t : Set.powersetCard J (n - k)) :
    tensorEquiv b c n ((b.prod c).exteriorPower n
      ((Set.powersetCard.sumEquiv n).symm ⟨k, s, t⟩)) =
      DirectSum.lof R _ (TensorBlock R V W n) k
        (b.exteriorPower k s ⊗ₜ[R] c.exteriorPower (n - k) t)

name: T3.ExteriorTensor.tensorEquiv_symm_basis
statement:
theorem tensorEquiv_symm_basis (n : ℕ) (k : Fin (n + 1))
    (s : Set.powersetCard I k) (t : Set.powersetCard J (n - k)) :
    (tensorEquiv b c n).symm
      (DirectSum.lof R _ (TensorBlock R V W n) k
        (b.exteriorPower k s ⊗ₜ[R] c.exteriorPower (n - k) t)) =
      (b.prod c).exteriorPower n ((Set.powersetCard.sumEquiv n).symm ⟨k, s, t⟩)

name: T3.ExteriorTensor.tensorEquiv_symm_comp_lof
statement:
theorem tensorEquiv_symm_comp_lof (n : ℕ) (k : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (tensorEquiv b c n).symm.toLinearMap.comp
      (DirectSum.lof R _ (TensorBlock R V W n) k) = wedgeMap R V W n k

name: T3.ExteriorTensor.tensorEquiv_symm_tmul_coe
statement:
theorem tensorEquiv_symm_tmul_coe (n : ℕ) (k : Fin (n + 1))
    (x : ⋀[R]^k.val V) (y : ⋀[R]^(n - k.val) W) :
    ((tensorEquiv b c n).symm
      (DirectSum.lof R _ (TensorBlock R V W n) k (x ⊗ₜ[R] y)) :
        ExteriorAlgebra R (V × W)) =
      (exteriorPower.map k (LinearMap.inl R V W) x : ExteriorAlgebra R (V × W)) *
      (exteriorPower.map (n - k) (LinearMap.inr R V W) y : ExteriorAlgebra R (V × W))

name: T3.ExteriorTensor.tensorEquiv_symm_toLinearMap
statement:
theorem tensorEquiv_symm_toLinearMap (n : ℕ) :

name: T3.ExteriorTensor.tensorEquiv_wedgeMap

name: T3.ExteriorTensor.wedgeMap_tensorEquiv_component
statement:
theorem wedgeMap_tensorEquiv_component (n : ℕ) (k : Fin (n + 1)) (x : ⋀[R]^n (V × W)) :
    wedgeMap R V W n k (tensorEquiv b c n x k) =
      ExteriorSum.projection (b.prod c) n k x

name: T3.ExteriorTensor.wedgeMap_tmul_coe
statement:
theorem wedgeMap_tmul_coe (n : ℕ) (k : Fin (n + 1))
    (x : ⋀[R]^k.val V) (y : ⋀[R]^(n - k.val) W) :
    (wedgeMap R V W n k (x ⊗ₜ[R] y) : ExteriorAlgebra R (V × W)) =
      (exteriorPower.map k (LinearMap.inl R V W) x : ExteriorAlgebra R (V × W)) *
      (exteriorPower.map (n - k) (LinearMap.inr R V W) y : ExteriorAlgebra R (V × W))

name: T3.ExteriorLowDegree.mixedOneTwoMap_tmul
statement:
theorem mixedOneTwoMap_tmul (v : V) (q : ⋀[R]^2 W) :
    mixedOneTwoMap R V W (v ⊗ₜ[R] q) =
      gradedMul (exteriorPower.map 1 (LinearMap.inl R V W)
        ((exteriorPower.oneEquiv R V).symm v))
        (exteriorPower.map 2 (LinearMap.inr R V W) q)

name: T3.ExteriorLowDegree.mixedTwoMap_tmul
statement:
theorem mixedTwoMap_tmul (v : V) (w : W) :
    mixedTwoMap R V W (v ⊗ₜ[R] w) =
      gradedMul (exteriorPower.map 1 (LinearMap.inl R V W)
        ((exteriorPower.oneEquiv R V).symm v))
        (exteriorPower.map 1 (LinearMap.inr R V W)
          ((exteriorPower.oneEquiv R W).symm w))

name: T3.ExteriorLowDegree.mixedTwoOneMap_tmul
statement:
theorem mixedTwoOneMap_tmul (q : ⋀[R]^2 V) (w : W) :
    mixedTwoOneMap R V W (q ⊗ₜ[R] w) =
      gradedMul (exteriorPower.map 2 (LinearMap.inl R V W) q)
        (exteriorPower.map 1 (LinearMap.inr R V W)
          ((exteriorPower.oneEquiv R W).symm w))

name: T3.ExteriorLowDegree.threeEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem threeEquiv_apply (q : ⋀[R]^3 V) (t : (⋀[R]^2 V) ⊗[R] W)
    (u : V ⊗[R] (⋀[R]^2 W)) (r : ⋀[R]^3 W) :
    threeEquiv b c (q, t, u, r) = exteriorPower.map 3 (LinearMap.inl R V W) q +
      mixedTwoOneMap R V W t + mixedOneTwoMap R V W u +
        exteriorPower.map 3 (LinearMap.inr R V W) r

name: T3.ExteriorLowDegree.threeEquiv_toLinearMap
statement: theorem threeEquiv_toLinearMap : (threeEquiv b c).toLinearMap = threeMap R V W

name: T3.ExteriorLowDegree.twoEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem twoEquiv_apply (q : ⋀[R]^2 V) (t : V ⊗[R] W) (r : ⋀[R]^2 W) :
    twoEquiv b c (q, t, r) = exteriorPower.map 2 (LinearMap.inl R V W) q +
      mixedTwoMap R V W t + exteriorPower.map 2 (LinearMap.inr R V W) r

name: T3.ExteriorLowDegree.twoEquiv_toLinearMap
statement: theorem twoEquiv_toLinearMap : (twoEquiv b c).toLinearMap = twoMap R V W

    (Δ : Finset H) (hΔ : Δ.card ≤ n) {h : H}
